public_rationale: The little-progress component conflicts with an independent study available before the post. Historical model comparisons showed substantial gains in the length and difficulty of software tasks agents could complete, alongside better recovery from mistakes. This supports contradiction under the ordinary capability reading. It does not establish improving financial returns or dependable automation of whole jobs; the separate returns-per-investment interpretation remains unsettled.
limitations: The evidence was a preprint and concentrates on software and reasoning tasks.
The paper reports substantial uncertainty and sensitivity to task selection.
Its 50% success measure is not reliable autonomous completion.
The overall grade depends on interpreting meaningful task gains as doing materially more.

our_interpretation: The plain reading is that frontier LLM capabilities improved little between April 2024 and publication in April 2025.
Substantial improvements in completing useful software and reasoning tasks count as doing materially more, even without reliable automation of entire jobs.
Diminishing returns could mean slowing capability gains or declining gains per unit of investment. Those meanings require different measurements.
The assessment covers the supplied capability proposition, not the separate allegation about investors' and journalists' conduct.
A substantial contradiction of the little-progress component is sufficient to contradict the combined assertion; it does not establish increasing returns to investment.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evaluations covering models available during the preceding year show substantial improvements on meaningful tasks, contradicting the assertion that the models do little more.

evidence.explanation: The study available on this date compares historical models, including April 2024 GPT-4 Turbo and early-2025 systems, on software and reasoning tasks. Its measured improvements in task length, error recovery, and tool use contradict little meaningful capability progress, while leaving returns per dollar unmeasured.
